events.text: The Celts have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Founders' Legacy (+2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from [ICON_BUILDING_MONUMENT] Monuments and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from [ICON_BUILDING_GRANARY] Granaries)

England has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Voice of the Surf (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Atolls, and from [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crab, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, Red Caviar, and Caviar resources)
